headline: Healthcare Realty Lifts Full-Year 2026 Outlook Following Q3 Earnings Beat
summary: Healthcare Realty raised its full-year 2026 financial outlook after reporting third-quarter earnings that surpassed analyst expectations.
why: Healthcare Realty is a prominent US real estate investment trust specializing in medical outpatient facilities, giving investors insight into healthcare real estate occupancy and cash flows.

impacts.name: Healthcare Realty
impacts.why: Third-quarter performance exceeded market forecasts, leading management to raise full-year guidance.
